purpose: One-time external replication of the already frozen M2.22 Type-I T+5 contrast on a disjoint 60-symbol A-share set.

population.source_clock: M2.17 source-aligned Terminal Price Bar reconstructed from no-lookahead forming projections.
population.maturity: At least 20 post-Terminal trading bars must be visible by the frozen snapshot cutoff.
population.eligibility: T2 must still be pending at T+5. Events that reach T2 on T+1..T+5 are excluded before group assignment.

exposure.name: full_prz_exit_by_t5
exposure.definition: First conservative full PRZ exit in the reversal direction occurs on T+1..T+5.

comparator.name: no_full_exit_by_t5
comparator.definition: No conservative full PRZ exit in the reversal direction occurs on T+1..T+5.

endpoint.name: first_t2_hit_t6_t20
endpoint.definition: Among T+5-pending-T2 events, first T2 hit occurs on T+6..T+20.

confirmatory_test.coverage_gate: At least 48 of the 60 frozen replication symbols must provide valid QFQ research snapshots; otherwise the replication is inconclusive regardless of effect.
confirmatory_test.confirm_if: coverage gate passes, both groups meet the sample floor, and the lower bound of the 95% Newcombe interval for exposure-minus-comparator is strictly greater than 0.
confirmatory_test.not_confirmed_if: coverage and group floors pass but the 95% Newcombe lower bound is <= 0.
confirmatory_test.inconclusive_if: provider coverage is below the frozen gate or either group is below the frozen sample floor.

interpretation_contract: A confirmed replication would provide independent-instrument historical corroboration of the frozen Type-I T+5 association. It would still not be a return probability, trading win rate, buy/sell rule, or modification of Carney geometry. A failed or inconclusive replication must be reported as such without retuning on the same replication set.
